display_name: WSM Desktop RC4 — попередній перегляд інсталятора
scope: read-only hardware evidence report (wsm-hwcheck 0.2.0, report schema 1.0.0)
one shared installer plan and preview contract exposed through the CLI, Guided, TUI and Calamares entrypoints
privileged agent validates and previews plans only; APPLY is disabled, every planned step is not-run, and no installation command is launched
journal and recovery-report utilities; preview mode does not perform or journal real disk mutations
read-only environment preflight; preview performs no block-device or filesystem mutation

pinned Free Guix channel snapshot with authentication evidence recorded in issue #39; the separate Compatibility lock pins Nonguix but its structural check alone is not cryptographic authentication or a successful build
source bundle builder is configured to create an archive from the exact Git commit, with SHA-256 checksums and a release manifest; this PR does not build or publish the bundle
KDE Plasma desktop profile, a minimal console live profile and a live-ISO recipe shipped as source; this release metadata does not claim those desktop recipes were built into a verified ISO
excluded: any write to a physical or virtual target block device, partition table, filesystem, mount point, EFI variable or bootloader
real installer APPLY: no installation has completed in QEMU or on physical hardware; all planned steps remain not-run
a verified bootable ISO built from the KDE desktop/live recipes in this source bundle
a built or verified Compatibility image; systems/live-compat.scm and channels/compatibility.lock.scm are separate source inputs only
the Nix/NixOS backend: ADR 0004 keeps GNU Guix as the only supported system backend for this preview
a performance claim: the baseline harness exists, but no physical-machine measurement is published
the RC4 source archive, tag and release assets have not been built or published by this source-only PR
verified physical reference-hardware compatibility: this source preview has no published physical functional-acceptance profile
